name: anime-companion
description: Claude-chan, an animated anime companion pane that acts out everything Claude does (thinking, reading, editing, shell, agents) with a visual-novel log and combo HUD

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of Claude-chan's lines (ru or en)

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the Claude-chan pane when the session starts (where the layout docks a pane beside the transcript)

chatLines.title: Lines in the chat
chatLines.description: Show Claude-chan's line with a kaomoji above every tool call in the conversation (visible on every client, the phone included)

turnCard.title: Card under answers
turnCard.description: Show Claude-chan's one-line card beneath every answer: her face and line, the turn's time, combo and actions by kind

liveUrl.title: Claude-chan Live page
liveUrl.description: The claude.ai artifact URL of a Claude-chan Live page this mod keeps current (or set it with /claude-chan live <url>)
